Sibling objectui#10501 (the lookup cell, same class) is queued and unclaimed. No live `pm:dispatched` claim names these files.

### Scope

The triage (`5828838619`): 「gate the row once at the shared seam (`useRecordSearch` taking a read policy, or the callers wrapping `getRecordDisplayName`), and decide with #10501 whether the field-read rule earns one shared export.」
- Reproduce first: a hit whose display field (or a `titleFormat` token) is policy-denied prints that value in the CommandPalette / SearchResultsPage / global-search label today.
- Fix: the label is computed from the row with policy-denied fields removed (`id` kept), following objectui#10411's / objectui#10434's rule `!perms.isLoaded || perms.checkField(object, f, 'read')`, applied ONCE at the shared seam. ⛔ No per-caller copy of the rule.
- Shared export: measure whether an exported helper for "the row as the user may read it" already exists after objectui#10434 / PR objectui#10491. Reuse it if so. If none exists, say in the report whether one belongs in a shared package for this card and objectui#10501. ⛔ A new public export makes this `Clause-②: yes`, so stop and report before adding one.
- Pin: a denied display field does not print in each of the three surfaces, with a lit control (an allowed field prints).

⇒ `Fixes #10500`.
